title: Plan
description: Planner output. Model gemini-3.5-flash, thinking high. A plain-language personal need goes in, a structured build plan comes out. Documented in shared/schemas/README.md. All eight keys are always present, even on rejection. No em dashes in any string value.

rejected.description: True when the request needs auth, multi-user state, server logic, real-time multiplayer, a database, payments, or implies shipping to other users.

rejection_reason.description: Why the request was rejected, or null when accepted.

suggested_alternative.description: An in-scope single-screen alternative that keeps the spirit of the request, or null when accepted.

core_interactions.description: Two to three core interactions the tool must support. Feeds the functionality judge tests.

data_model.description: The data the tool keeps, assuming localStorage only. No backend, no database.

success_criteria.description: How we know the tool actually solves the need. Drives the Playwright functionality checks.

candidate_strategies.description: Two to three implementation strategies that differ meaningfully for candidate diversity.

tool_category.description: Inferred tool category from the shared tag vocabulary.

id.description: Strategy id. Becomes the candidate_id downstream.

ux_emphasis.description: Layout and density emphasis. Candidates share tokens and differ only here.

core_interactions: Start and pause the interval timer
examples.data_model: Rounds and durations held in localStorage. Current round index in memory.
success_criteria: Starting the timer counts down the first round
Completing a round advances to the next
